owner_sources.title:
It looks like someone (FHRCC?) is trying to poll Florida HD 60 but forgot to change the candidates. 

They’re polling Democrat Lindsay Polega-Quigley against Republican Chad Johnson (the GOP nominee in HD 22) instead of Melissa Rutland, the actual GOP nominee in HD 60. 

Yikes…
